author: mcpietrooficial
title: Péssima segurança
content:
Fui hackeado com facilidade, e mesmo tendo ativado a “autenticação em 2 fatores” que precisaria do código enviado ao meu número para qualquer transação dentro da plataforma.
O hacker conseguiu tranquilamente transferir meu dinheiro para outra conta sem precisar dos códigos que chegaram no meu celular.
Reclamei no suporte e o que fizeram foi me encher de perguntas sobre como o possível hacker poderia ter me hackeado, e simplesmente bloquearam minha conta no meio do atendimento, alegando que eu deveria mudar a senha.

Não deram retorno sobre meu dinheiro perdido, mesmo eu tento todo o histórico de transferência do hacker.

Só passando pra informar que a segurança é ruim e o atendimento também, estou voltando pra BINANCE

author: Lincolnosoares
title: Coinbase Will Rob You!!
content:
I am writing to express my complete outrage and deep dissatisfaction with the utterly irresponsible and unacceptable way Coinbase has been handling my case for several months now.

I had an account registered under my former corporate email, where I had invested real money – U.S. dollars – through your platform. Since losing access to that email, I’ve been trying repeatedly to recover my account. Despite providing all necessary information to verify my identity, Coinbase not only failed to assist me but actually DELETED my account, leaving me with no way to retrieve my funds.

This is absolutely outrageous. Coinbase is arbitrarily holding my money with no accountability. For a platform that claims to be secure and user-oriented, this is a blatant violation of trust, showing a complete lack of professionalism and respect.

I’ve been trying to resolve this issue for MONTHS, and all I’ve received in return is silence, bureaucracy, and dismissiveness.

I demand an immediate solution to recover the funds I invested. If no resolution is provided, I will escalate this matter through every available channel – including formal complaints to consumer protection agencies, public exposure on social media, and, if necessary, legal action.

Coinbase cannot simply delete a user’s account and make their money disappear. This is not just negligence – it borders on theft.

I expect an URGENT response
